items.title: Congratulamini mihi (Le Heurteur)
items.desc: Guillaume Le Heurteur, Congratulamini mihi, c. 1528. 5 voices (Superius 1, Superius 2, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
